axis_ids.description: Deterministic id of the axis entity.

count.description: Total number of instances, including the original.

elem.description: Element id (tab) — the <elem> segment of the document URL.

entities.description: FeatureScript query selecting what to pattern.

equal_spacing.description: Space instances evenly over the angle (default true).

name.description: Feature name shown in the tree (default "Circular Pattern").

type.description: What kind of thing is patterned (default PART).

validate.description: Re-read the feature list afterwards and fail if the feature regenerated with an error (default true).

ws.description: Workspace id — the <ws> segment of the document URL.
